title: Fri 09 Oct 2026: Nasdaq slides on OpenAI revenue report, Brent above 104 dollars, BoE November hike odds, FCA Connect for fund filings
summary: Tech leads Wall Street lower after a report that OpenAI revenue is short of signals, while Brent jumps above 104 dollars and Treasury yields stay near 24-year highs. Markets price about an 83 percent chance of a Bank of England hike on 5 November, and the FCA moves fund authorisation filings onto Connect from 2 November. Plus active ETF launches, three COO action points and the week's diary.
